landing_blurb: You have to post something every day, but there are clients in the chair and a shop to run. Tell it what you did today; the layout, the images and the per-platform rewrite are handled for you. You just look it over, and say one more line if something feels off.

landing_faq_a1: Yes. If you can talk, you can use it: say what you want to post today, and the copy, images, image-text notes and short video are made for you; snapshots you take around the shop are ready to use as-is.
landing_faq_a2: Every set comes laid out for Xiaohongshu (RED), Douyin and Video Channels, with one top pick by default; take a look, say a word to change anything. Then copy the text, download the assets or export the package — for now you post it from your own account.
landing_faq_a3: All three. A single creation produces separate drafts tuned to each platform's conventions — not one draft posted everywhere. For WeChat Moments, export the segmented package and use it as-is.
landing_faq_a4: Pilot access is email sign-up plus a redemption code, with trial credits opened per shop; you can try copy, images, image-text notes and video. Nothing is auto-charged when credits run out.
landing_faq_a5: Your materials stay yours, used only to create content for your own shop; for anything showing a client, we confirm authorization with you first.
landing_faq_a6: By output: copy per piece, images per image, video per piece — three buckets counted separately; an image-text note is counted by the copy and images inside it. Visible in your account anytime.
